rubric_items.reason: api, web, db modules, both routes and the three read tables are listed. PatientService is named in prose but is not listed or cited as a changed element.
Every cited id resolves in the generated facts. Some links are weak: the route-to-page rendering is inferred, and REQ-4 does not cite the doctor name column.
Other callers of GET /api/patients are raised as U-1/Q-01, background jobs are ruled out (C10), and no table changes, so no table readers are missed.
REQ-2..6 are marked assumed with an explicit basis (single list route, client-only access, index). Known items cite facts. Unknowns raise questions.
The artifact is readable and the summary states the risks, but the 'Impacted modules' list mixes APIs and tables and is not ordered by risk.
